messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: 3xx/5xx spike on /v1/embeddings — 120s sustained error rate > 5% across eu-west-1. Pager routed to @Sasha K (primary).
Sasha K: On my way to train, stuck at station because of a signal failure. ETA ~45–60m. Sorry, I can take initial steps from mobile but won't be reliable for long.
Priya R: I can take primary until Sasha gets stable or arrives. I’m in PDT so will be up for the next 6h. Switching to primary now?
Sasha K: @Priya R yes pls. handing off — current state: embeddings service error rate 6.2%, requests returning 502s from the scaling tier. No config changes in last 2h.
Sasha K: quick notes — load on dedicated-pool-embeds is higher than usual, KV-cache miss rate jumped. I pushed a temporary routing rule earlier to route non-critical batch jobs to low-priority pool.
Priya R: taking primary. @Lucas D can you shadow and watch queues for any backlog? I’ll start triage.
Lucas D: on it. I’ll keep an eye on the request queue and token costs. Setting a watch on consumer-latency dashboard now.
Priya R: triage checklist: 1) confirm autoscale activity 2) check model-worker OOM/sigkill 3) look at recent deploys 4) rollback routing if needed. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-service (see section "production spike -> escalations").
Lucas D: autoscaler shows two scale-ups but failed to add new workers — errors show missing GPU images: "failed to pull model runtime image: image not found". Might be a provisioning issue in eu-west-1.
Maria C: ping infra-ops-bot for region provisioning status? I can open a cloud ticket if this is a platform-level problem.
oncall-bot: infra-ops-bot has been notified. Ticket #INFR-9331 created (eu-west-1 image registry outage suspected).
infra-ops-bot: Noted — registry error in eu-west-1  -> pushing fallback to pull from mirror (should be live in ~7m). Monitoring mirror sync.
Priya R: good. Meanwhile lowering inference concurrency on dedicated-pool-embeds to limit OOMs: scaled concurrency from 8->4 for model x-embed-large. That should reduce failure rate for now.
Lucas D: concurrency change accepted. Error rate dropped to 3.4% within 6m. Request latency slightly up but acceptable.
Sasha K: thanks all — I’m boarding a replacement bus, still likely ~25m delay. If infra mirror doesn't come up, we should failover regionally or route traffic to hosted-embeds fallback (higher cost).
Priya R: agreed. @Maria C can you prepare a regional failover plan? Steps: 1) enable cross-region routing policy for embeddings to route eu->us-west-2 for non-SLA traffic 2) notify growth if cost increase >10% 3) enable host-fallback flag.
Maria C: on it. Drafting the routing change now. Will post exact commands once I have them.
Lucas D: queue backlog at 10k -> starting gradual reject for non-critical batch jobs to avoid cascading timeouts. Posting command: ```/rls reject --service embeddings --tag batch --pct 80```
Priya R: good call. Keep me posted. If the mirror fix rolls out we can revert routing in minutes.
infra-ops-bot: mirror sync completed. eu-west-1 image pulls healthy again.
Lucas D: re-enabled autoscale to allow new nodes to join. New workers coming up. Error rate down to 0.9% now.
Priya R: trending back to normal. I’ll run a quick smoke: 50 synthetic requests, ok.
Sasha K: awesome, thanks team — I’ll be reachable but probably slow to respond for next 30m. Priya, Lucas, Maria — thanks for picking this up.
Priya R: no problem. I’ll keep primary until Sasha confirms back on keyboard. Lucas will keep shadow for next hour. Maria will hold region failover roll.
Maria C: standing by. Notifying support to prepare a brief customer message if we hit SLA thresholds.
Sasha K: ETA update — 18m to office wifi recovery. Thanks again. :pray:
Priya R: closing notes for the handoff: actions taken (reduced concurrency, rejected batch jobs, regional routing on standby), mirror resolved, autoscale resumed. I’ll add a short post-incident summary in #incidents later.
Lucas D: logging runbook amendments: add mirror fallback check to step 2 so future handoffs have exact commands.
Sasha K: thanks — feel free to reassign primary when I confirm I'm back at desk.
Priya R: roger.
Maria C: :thumbsup:
